Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

BundleFile.description: One file of a bundle and the checksum a transfer is verified against (MF-42).

path.description: Path inside the bundle, as the archive carries it.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the file's bytes as exported.

BundleItem.description: One resource listed in a [`BundleSpec`] index.

kind.description: Manifest kind of the exported resource; must be a kind this crate knows.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource, absent for organization-scoped kinds.

path.description: Path of the manifest inside the bundle archive.

BundleModel.description: One organization model a project export carries (MF-49, ADR-N-039 §3.4).

file.description: Its LinkML source, relative to the index, under `models/`.

manifest.description: Its `DataModel` manifest, relative to the index, under `models/`.

name.description: The model's name in the organization it came from.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the LinkML source: what an import compares a destination model's source with (MF-50).

version.description: The version the organization held when the project was exported.

BundleModelOrigin.description: The organization a carried model belongs to, and its name there (MF-49).

name.description: The model's name in that organization.

BundleRepository.description: One repository of a git-native export (MF-45).

file.description: The `git bundle` file, relative to the index.

head.description: The commit the repository's default branch ends at, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

name.description: The repository's name, and the name it is created under at the target.

BundleRole.description: What a repository of a git-native export is (MF-45, PF-85).

BundleSchemas.description: The schemas of a complete export: one per kind in the bundle, and the LinkML source and JSON Schema of every `DataModel` it holds (MF-41).

kinds.description: Kind name to its JSON Schema (draft-07).

models.description: DataModel name to `{linkml, jsonSchema}`; a member is absent when neither the repository nor Model Tools could produce it.

BundleSpec.description:
Desired specification of a [`Bundle`][crate::kinds::Bundle] download index (MF-17, MF-18).

A Bundle is generated on download and never stored in the repository; it travels inside the archive so the import wizard knows what it received and from where.

exportedBy.description: Who produced it (a user or ServiceAccount name).

files.description: The SHA-256 of every file the bundle holds, over the bytes as exported (MF-42). An import compares what it wrote against these, so a transfer between instances is verified before the source is deleted. A bundle from an older exporter carries none, and an import then reports nothing verified rather than reporting everything equal.

models.description: The organization models a git-native export carries because the project imports them (MF-49): schema files only, each listed in `files` too.

nativeFiles.description: Native files carried next to their envelopes (`bento.yaml`, `*.linkml.yaml`) (MF-17).

omitted.description: How many resources the caller was not allowed to read; names are never disclosed (MF-18).

readme.description: What the bundle holds, in prose: the text of the `README.md` a complete export carries at its root, so a stream export says the same thing as an archive (MF-41).

repositories.description: The git bundles of a git-native export, one per repository (MF-45): the project's and one per application of it. An import verifies each by its head commit (MF-46).

schemas.description: The schemas a complete export carries beside its manifests (MF-41).

sourceInstance.description: Base URL of the instance it came from, so a re-import can be traced (MF-25).

sourceRevision.description: Git revision the export was taken at, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

SemVer.description: Semantic version string conforming to major.minor.patch (DM-22)

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
